# Text area (`text-area`)

Multi-line input that grows with its text, with a character count.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createTextArea` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/textArea.d.ts`): `.mh-input.mh-input--multiline` inside a `.mh-field`: a textarea that grows with its text (`autoGrow`, up to `maxRows`) and an optional character counter.

```ts
export function createTextArea(options: TextAreaOptions): TextAreaHandle;

export interface TextAreaOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  success?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  /** Starting height in rows (default 3). */
  rows?: number;
  /** Grows with its text up to this many rows, then scrolls (default 10). */
  maxRows?: number;
  /** Grow with the text (default true). */
  autoGrow?: boolean;
  maxLength?: number;
  /** Shows a character counter (with `maxLength`, `n / max`). */
  showCount?: boolean;
  onInput?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
  onChange?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface TextAreaHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
  /** Re-measures the height (call after the element is shown, if it was hidden when the value was set). */
  resize(): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createTextArea } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const announcement = createTextArea({
  label: 'Announcement',
  placeholder: 'What should the speakers say?',
  value: 'Dinner is ready in ten minutes.',
  maxLength: 140,
  showCount: true,
  maxRows: 6,
  onChange: (value) => announcement.setError(value.trim() ? undefined : 'Write a message before sending.'),
});

document.body.append(announcement.el);
```

## React API

`TextArea` (types in `dist/react/text-inputs.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createTextArea`; grows with its text after each change.

```ts
export function TextArea({ label, helper, error, success, labelStyle, maxRows, autoGrow = true, showCount, required, disabled, className, rows = 3, value, defaultValue, onChange, maxLength, ...rest }: TextAreaProps);

export interface TextAreaProps extends FieldParts, TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement> {
  /** Grows with its text up to this many rows (default 10). */
  maxRows?: number;
  /** Grow with the text (default true). */
  autoGrow?: boolean;
  showCount?: boolean;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TextArea } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function TextAreaExample() {
  const [text, setText] = useState('Dinner is ready in ten minutes.');
  return (
    <TextArea
      label="Announcement"
      placeholder="What should the speakers say?"
      error={text.trim() ? undefined : 'Write a message before sending.'}
      maxLength={140}
      showCount
      maxRows={6}
      value={text}
      onChange={(event) => setText(event.target.value)}
    />
  );
}
```
